$description: Columns (library wave 3, extend): the tokens of the sidebar ratios and of the collapse into one column below a window class. The count, gap and divided tokens are in components.tokens.json.

columns-sidebar-start-columns.$description: Sidebar at the start: the narrow first column takes one third of the row, the main column two thirds.

columns-sidebar-end-columns.$description: Sidebar at the end: the main column takes two thirds of the row, the narrow last column one third.

columns-collapse-row-gap.$description: Collapsed into one column: the space between the stacked columns (the same layout step as the medium column gap).

columns-collapse-divider-color.$description: Collapsed divided columns: the line above each column after the first (the divider color of the side-by-side lines).

columns-collapse-divider-width.$description: Collapsed divided columns: the width of the line above each column after the first.
